1.web: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was struck, in the same day, the hand of Yahweh was on me, and he brought me there.
1.asv: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day, the hand of Jehovah was upon me, and he brought me thither.

2.web: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, whereon was as it were the frame of a city on the south.
2.asv: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me down upon a very high mountain, whereon was as it were the frame of a city on the south.

3.web: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
3.asv: And he brought me thither; and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

4.web: The man said to me, Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I shall show you; for, to the intent that I may show them to you, you are brought here: declare all that you see to the house of Israel.
4.asv: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thy heart upon all that I shall show thee; for, to the intent that I may show them unto thee, art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.

5.web: Behold, a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand breadth each: so he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
5.asv: And, behold, a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a handbreadth each: so he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

6.web: Then came he to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps: and he measured the threshold of the gate, one reed broad; and the other threshold, one reed broad.
6.asv: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the steps thereof: and he measured the threshold of the gate, one reed broad; and the other threshold, one reed broad.

7.web: Every lodge was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the lodges was five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.
7.asv: And every lodge was one reed long, and one reed broad; and the space between the lodges was five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.

8.web: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.
8.asv: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.

9.web: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its posts, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.
9.asv: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.

10.web: The lodges of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
10.asv: And the lodges of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

11.web: He measured the breadth of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;
11.asv: And he measured the breadth of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;

12.web: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the lodges, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
12.asv: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the lodges, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

13.web: He measured the gate from the roof of the one lodge to the roof of the other, a breadth of twenty-five cubits; door against door.
13.asv: And he measured the gate from the roof of the one lodge to the roof of the other, a breadth of five and twenty cubits; door against door.

14.web: He made also posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.
14.asv: He made also posts, threescore cubits; and the court reached unto the posts, round about the gate.

15.web: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.
15.asv: And from the forefront of the gate at the entrance unto the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.

16.web: There were closed windows to the lodges, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches; and windows were around inward; and on each post were palm trees.
16.asv: And there were closed windows to the lodges, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches; and windows were round about inward; and upon each post were palm-trees.

17.web: Then brought he me into the outer court; and behold, there were rooms and a pavement, made for the court all around: thirty rooms were on the pavement.
17.asv: Then brought he me into the outer court; and, lo, there were chambers and a pavement, made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.

18.web: The pavement was by the side of the gates, answerable to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.
18.asv: And the pavement was by the side of the gates, answerable unto the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.

19.web: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.
19.asv: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, a hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.

20.web: The gate of the outer court whose prospect is toward the north, he measured its length and its breadth.
20.asv: And the gate of the outer court whose prospect is toward the north, he measured the length thereof and the breadth thereof.

21.web: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side; and its posts and its arches were after the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.
21.asv: And the lodges thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

22.web: The windows of it, and its arches, and the palm trees of it, were after the measure of the gate whose prospect is toward the east; and they went up to it by seven steps; and its arches were before them.
22.asv: And the windows thereof, and the arches thereof, and the palm-trees thereof, were after the measure of the gate whose prospect is toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.

23.web: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east; and he measured from gate to gate one hundred cubits.
23.asv: And there was a gate to the inner court over against the other gate, both on the north and on the east; and he measured from gate to gate a hundred cubits.

24.web: He led me toward the south; and behold, a gate toward the south: and he measured its posts and its arches according to these measures.
24.asv: And he led me toward the south; and, behold, a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.

25.web: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.
25.asv: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

26.web: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them; and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.
26.asv: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them; and it had palm-trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.

27.web: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south a hundred cubits.
27.asv: And there was a gate to the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south a hundred cubits.

28.web: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
28.asv: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;

29.web: and its lodges, and its posts, and its arches, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in its arches all around; it was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits broad.
29.asv: and the lodges thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about; it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

30.web: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long, and five cubits broad.
30.asv: And there were arches round about, five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.

31.web: The arches of it were toward the outer court; and palm trees were on its posts: and the ascent to it had eight steps.
31.asv: And the arches thereof were toward the outer court; and palm-trees were upon the posts thereof: and the ascent to it had eight steps.

32.web: He brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures;
32.asv: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures;

33.web: and its lodges, and its posts, and its arches, according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in its arches all around; it was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits broad.
33.asv: and the lodges thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about; it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

34.web: The arches of it were toward the outer court; and palm trees were on its posts, on this side, and on that side: and the ascent to it had eight steps.
34.asv: And the arches thereof were toward the outer court; and palm-trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the ascent to it had eight steps.

35.web: He brought me to the north gate: and he measured it according to these measures;
35.asv: And he brought me to the north gate: and he measureditaccording to these measures;

36.web: its lodges, its posts, and its arches: and there were windows therein all around; the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits.
36.asv: the lodges thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof: and there were windows therein round about; the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

37.web: The posts of it were toward the outer court; and palm trees were on its posts, on this side, and on that side: and the ascent to it had eight steps.
37.asv: And the posts thereof were toward the outer court; and palm-trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the ascent to it had eight steps.

38.web: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates; there they washed the burnt offering.
38.asv: And a chamber with the door thereof was by the posts at the gates; there they washed the burnt-offering.

39.web: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.
39.asv: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt-offering and the sin-offering and the trespass-offering.

40.web: On the one side outside, as one goes up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables.
40.asv: And on the one side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables.

41.web: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they killed the sacrifices.
41.asv: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew the sacrifices.

42.web: There were four tables for the burnt offering, of cut stone, a cubit and a half long, and a cubit and a half broad, and one cubit high; whereupon they laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
42.asv: And there were four tables for the burnt-offering, of hewn stone, a cubit and a half long, and a cubit and a half broad, and one cubit high; whereupon they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt-offering and the sacrifice.

43.web: The hooks, a hand breadth long, were fastened within all around: and on the tables was the flesh of the offering.
43.asv: And the hooks, a handbreadth long, were fastened within round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the oblation.

44.web: Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south; one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.
44.asv: And without the inner gate were chambers for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south; one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.

45.web: He said to me, This room, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the duty of the house;
45.asv: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house;

46.web: and the room whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the duty of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to Yahweh to minister to him.
46.asv: and the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to Jehovah to minister unto him.

47.web: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long, and a hundred cubits broad, square; and the altar was before the house.
47.asv: And he measured the court, a hundred cubits long, and a hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar was before the house.

48.web: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
48.asv: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.

49.web: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; even by the steps by which they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
49.asv: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; even by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
